Obtain the other root, e.g. $-\sqrt6-\sqrt2\,i$ — A1. Printed anomaly: the official scheme repeats the negative-imaginary root on both lines; it does not print the conjugate $-\sqrt6+\sqrt2\,i$. Total: 3.
